admin_activity_caption_asc: Activity log, oldest first, page {page} of {pages}
admin_activity_caption_desc: Activity log, newest first, page {page} of {pages}
admin_activity_description: Who did what in eduLIMS: sign-ins, role changes, blocks and ended sessions. Filter the log and share its address to show someone the same view.
admin_activity_detail_unreadable: The details of this event could not be read.
admin_activity_empty_body: Sign-ins, role changes and blocks appear here as they happen.
admin_activity_empty_filtered_body: No event matches these filters. Change them or clear them.
admin_activity_period_hint: Pick the first day, then the last day. Days are in the Amsterdam time zone.
admin_activity_reason_admin_grant: an administrator grant from the host
admin_activity_reason_admin_grant_overri: an administrator grant for an account named by its id
admin_activity_reason_admin_revoke: the administrator role was withdrawn on the host
admin_activity_reason_invalid_code: the sign-in code was not valid
admin_activity_reason_own_roles: nobody can change their own roles
admin_activity_reason_role_conflict: the roles do not go together
admin_activity_reason_roles_not_local: the roles come from the identity provider
admin_activity_reason_state_not_found: the sign-in took too long or was started elsewhere
admin_activity_user_search_hint: Type part of a name or email address.
admin_activity_user_search_label: Search by name or email address
admin_analysers_caption_asc: Analysers, sorted by {column} in ascending order, page {page} of {pages}
admin_analysers_caption_desc: Analysers, sorted by {column} in descending order, page {page} of {pages}
admin_analysers_description: Every lab analyser, where it stands and how its results reach FerroEHR. Only administrators can change the register; every change is recorded in the activity log.
admin_analysers_empty_body: Add the first analyser with Add analyser.
admin_analysers_empty_filtered_body: Change the search or the filters, or clear them.
admin_analysers_error_failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
admin_analysers_error_not_found: This analyser no longer exists. Reload the list.
admin_analysers_error_retired: This analyser is retired and can no longer be changed.
admin_analysers_error_serial_taken: An analyser of this model with this serial number is already in the register.
admin_analysers_form_description: Every field but the notes needs a value. The serial number must be unique for the model.
admin_analysers_location_help: The lab room or bench, for example Lab 2.14, bench 3.
admin_analysers_model_help: The manufacturer and model, for example Abbott Afinion 2.
admin_analysers_model_required: Enter the model of the analyser.
admin_analysers_no_actions: No actions for the retired analyser {name}
admin_analysers_notes_help: Anything an administrator should know, up to {max} characters. No personal data.
admin_analysers_retire_body: A retired analyser stays in the register as a record, so earlier results keep their device, but it can no longer be changed. This cannot be undone.
admin_analysers_route_help: HL7 through FerroBRIDGE for an analyser that sends its results itself (Afinion 2); Excel upload for one whose export students upload (Epoch 2).
admin_analysers_route_required: Choose how the results reach FerroEHR.
admin_analysers_search_label: Search model, serial number or location
admin_analysers_serial_required: Enter the serial number from the type plate.
admin_analysers_status_required: Choose In use or In maintenance.
admin_integrations_check_failed: The check could not run. Try again.
admin_integrations_description: eduLIMS checks both services every minute. A service that does not answer shows as Unavailable within a few minutes.
admin_integrations_error_auth_refused: The service answered but refused eduLIMS's credentials (401 or 403). Check the credentials eduLIMS uses for it.
admin_integrations_error_http_client: The service did not accept the request (a 4xx answer). Check the address eduLIMS is configured with.
admin_integrations_error_http_server: The service answered with an error (a 5xx answer). Check its logs.
admin_integrations_error_timeout: The service did not answer within 5 seconds.
admin_integrations_error_unexpected: The service answered, but not with a health answer. Check the configured address.
admin_integrations_error_unreachable: No connection to the service. Check that it runs and that its address is right.
admin_integrations_ferrobridge_descripti: Receives the HL7 messages of the Afinion 2 and writes them to FerroEHR.
admin_integrations_ferroehr_description: Stores the measurements as openEHR compositions.
admin_integrations_page_description: Whether FerroEHR and FerroBRIDGE are reachable, and the register of lab analysers.
admin_integrations_state_unknown: Unknown: no check in the last 5 minutes
admin_overview_activity_empty_body: Sign-ins, role changes and other account events show here as they happen.
admin_system_build_description: What this server runs. A release image carries every value; a development server has none.
admin_system_providers_description: Read-only. Change a provider under Identity providers; client secrets and keys never show here.
admin_system_providers_empty_body: Nobody can sign in through an identity provider until you enable one under Identity providers.
admin_users_block_description: All sessions of this user end now, and every sign-in is refused, also through an identity provider.
admin_users_block_help: A blocked user is signed out at once and cannot sign in until the block ends or is lifted.
admin_users_block_reason_required: Enter the reason for the block.
admin_users_block_reason_too_long: Keep the reason to {max} characters or fewer.
admin_users_block_until_help: Optional. Without an end date the block lasts until an administrator lifts it.
admin_users_block_until_invalid: Choose a date from the calendar.
admin_users_blocked_indefinitely: Until an administrator lifts the block
admin_users_bulk_end_sessions_body: Selected: {count}. They are signed out on every device.
admin_users_bulk_end_sessions_title: End all sessions of the selected users?
admin_users_caption_asc: Users, sorted by {column} in ascending order, page {page} of {pages}
admin_users_caption_desc: Users, sorted by {column} in descending order, page {page} of {pages}
admin_users_description: Find people, see where their roles come from, end their sessions and block or unblock them.
admin_users_empty_body: People appear here after their first sign-in.
admin_users_empty_filtered_body: No user matches this search and these filters. Change them or clear them.
admin_users_end_all_sessions_body: {name} is signed out on every device.
admin_users_end_other_sessions_body: You are signed out on every other device. This session stays open.
admin_users_end_session_body: {name} is signed out on {device} and has to sign in there again.
admin_users_error_block_self: You cannot block your own account.
admin_users_error_current_session: You cannot end the session you are using. Sign out instead.
admin_users_error_roles_not_local: The identity provider manages these roles. Change them there.
admin_users_roles_confirm_body: The new roles are {roles}. They apply at once: the user sees only the portals of these roles.
admin_users_roles_edit_help: A student cannot also be a teacher or an administrator; a teacher can also be an administrator.
admin_users_roles_idp_help: {source} manages these roles and sets them again at every sign-in. Change them in {source}.
admin_users_roles_local_help: An administrator assigned these roles in eduLIMS. You can change them here.
admin_users_roles_own: You cannot change your own roles. Ask another administrator.
admin_users_search_label: Search by name or email address
admin_users_unblock_body: The user can sign in again at once.
app_description: A laboratory information management system for practical laboratory education.
coming_soon_body: This part of eduLIMS is still being built. It will appear here when it is ready.
data_table_select_page: Select all rows on this page
demo_accounts_dev_login_hint: Fill in an account with Use, then select Sign in with a test account. Password for every account: {password}
demo_accounts_filled: The {role} test account is filled in. Select Sign in with a test account to continue.
demo_accounts_keycloak_hint: Select a Keycloak sign-in button (OIDC or SAML), then use one of these. The password is the username.
demo_accounts_note: These are public development credentials. They work only while the development login is on, never in production.
dev_charts_focused: Focused: {practical}, {submissions} submissions, average grade {grade}, class size {size}, year {year}.
dev_charts_focused_none: No point is focused. Move the pointer over a point, or tab to the chart and use the arrow keys.
dev_charts_intro: A development-only page that shows the shared chart foundation with fictional demo data. It is not available in production.
dev_charts_scatter_description: Each point is one practical. Further right means more submissions, higher means a higher average grade, and a larger point a larger class. The academic year shows as a circle (year 1), a hexagon (year 2) or a ring (year 3). Use the arrow keys to move between points.
dev_charts_scatter_label: Scatter plot of {count} fictional practicals: submissions against average grade
dev_charts_table_caption: Fictional practicals with their submissions, average grade, class size and academic year
dev_forms_criterion_name_required: Enter a name for the criterion.
dev_forms_day_required: Choose the day of the session.
dev_forms_group_size_invalid: Enter the group size as a whole number from 1 to {max}.
dev_forms_intro: A development page with fictional data: every form field, validation while you type, a check on the server and a rubric editor. Nothing is saved.
dev_forms_level_label_required: Enter a name for the level.
dev_forms_observers_help: Paste or type up to {max} email addresses, one per line or separated by commas.
dev_forms_part_required: Choose a part of the day.
dev_forms_points_invalid: Enter the points as a whole number from 0 to {max}.
dev_forms_reminder_help: Nothing is sent from this page.
dev_forms_reminder_label: Send a reminder the day before
dev_forms_rubric_accepted: The server accepted the rubric. Nothing was saved.
dev_forms_session_accepted: The server accepted the session. Nothing was saved.
dev_forms_session_name_required: Enter a name for the session.
dev_forms_session_refused: The server refused the session, as you asked. Turn off the simulation and try again.
dev_forms_simulate_help: The stub server function then refuses the whole form.
dev_forms_simulate_label: Simulate a refusal from the server
dev_forms_title_help: The server checks the title while you type. Try “Titration basics”, which already exists.
dev_forms_title_required: Enter a title for the rubric.
dev_forms_title_taken: A rubric called “{title}” already exists. Choose another title.
dev_login_submit: Sign in with a test account
dev_virtual_intro: {count} fictional measurements in one list. Only the rows in view are rendered. Use the arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down to move through the list.
dev_virtual_note: Repeat measurement requested: the duplicate differs by more than the allowed margin.
dev_virtual_table_caption: {count} fictional measurements. On a row, use the arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down to move through the rows.
dev_virtual_table_intro: {count} fictional measurements in one table that is not paginated. Only the rows in view are rendered. Sort by sample ID, value or status from the column headers, and use the arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down to move through the rows.
error_body: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, or come back later.
form_email_list_invalid: {address} is not a valid email address. Correct or remove it.
home_no_role: Your account has no role yet. Contact an administrator.
home_sign_in_hint: Sign in with your organisation account to open your portal.
idp_attest_pkce_help: Needed only when the provider's discovery document does not list code_challenge_methods_supported. eduLIMS always sends PKCE with S256.
idp_attest_pkce_warning: Turn this on only when the provider's documentation states that it refuses a sign-in without PKCE S256. If it does not, a stolen authorization code can sign someone in. Turning it on is recorded in the activity log.
idp_created_done: {name} is added and switched off. Register its URLs, test it, then enable it.
idp_default_role_help: For a new user the provider sends no listed value for. Choose none to refuse them.
idp_delete_body: This cannot be undone. A provider people have signed in with cannot be deleted: disable it instead.
idp_description: The services people sign in with. Each has its own sign-in button, role mapping and email domains.
idp_disabled_done: {name} is disabled. Nobody can sign in with it.
idp_domains_help: One per line, such as example.edu. An address in one of these domains on the sign-in page goes to this provider.
idp_email_authoritative_help: Turn this on only when the provider controls every address it sends. Invitations and pending administrator grants match verified addresses only.
idp_empty_body: Add one here, or run pnpm idp:add on the host.
idp_enabled_done: {name} is enabled and shows on the sign-in page.
idp_error_domain: Enter domains such as example.edu, one per line.
idp_error_issuer: Enter the issuer as an https URL.
idp_error_label: Enter a name of at most 60 characters.
idp_error_metadata_required: Paste the metadata XML or enter its URL.
idp_error_metadata_size: The metadata is larger than 100 KB.
idp_error_metadata_url: Enter the metadata URL as an https URL.
idp_error_pem: Paste a PEM private key (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----).
idp_error_provider_id: Use 2 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (not local or credential).
idp_error_role_claim: Enter the claim or attribute name, without spaces.
idp_error_role_map_duplicate: Each provider value may appear once.
idp_error_role_value: Enter the value the provider sends.
idp_field_attest_pkce: This provider enforces PKCE with S256
idp_field_email_authoritative: This provider's email addresses are verified
idp_field_id_help: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It is part of the URLs you register at the identity provider and cannot change later.
idp_field_issuer_help: For Microsoft Entra ID: https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant id>/v2.0. eduLIMS reads the provider's discovery document from it.
idp_label_help: The sign-in button reads “Sign in with” and this name, and the Users screen names the role source by it.
idp_logout_none: This provider advertises no end-session endpoint: signing out ends the eduLIMS session only.
idp_logout_note: Signing out of eduLIMS also signs out of this provider, which then returns to the sign-in page.
idp_metadata_help: Paste the metadata XML or give its URL; eduLIMS fetches a URL once. The provider must sign its assertions and send a persistent NameID.
idp_metadata_keep: Metadata is stored. Leave both fields empty to keep it, or fill one to refresh it (for example after a certificate rotation).
idp_new_description: A new provider starts switched off. Save it, register the URLs it shows at the identity provider, test it, then enable it.
idp_refused_client_secret_required: The issuer moved to another address. Enter the client secret of the new provider; eduLIMS never sends the stored secret to another provider.
idp_refused_data_key: The data key cannot protect or read this provider's secrets. Check EDULIMS_DATA_KEY on the host.
idp_refused_discovery_failed: eduLIMS could not read the provider's discovery document. Check the issuer URL.
idp_refused_domain_taken: One of these domains already belongs to another provider.
idp_refused_endpoint_foreign_origin: The provider's endpoints are on another site than its issuer.
idp_refused_exists: A provider with this id already exists.
idp_refused_has_accounts: People have signed in with this provider, so it cannot be deleted. Disable it instead.
idp_refused_issuer_mismatch: The discovery document names another issuer. Enter the issuer exactly as the provider names it.
idp_refused_issuer_private: The URL points to a private network address. Only the host operator can allow that (EDULIMS_IDP_PRIVATE_ORIGINS).
idp_refused_issuer_unresolvable: The host name of the URL cannot be found.
idp_refused_last_enabled: This is the only enabled provider; nobody could sign in without it. Enable another one first.
idp_refused_metadata_fetch_failed: eduLIMS could not fetch the metadata from this URL.
idp_refused_metadata_invalid: This is not valid SAML identity provider metadata.
idp_refused_metadata_no_persistent_namei: The provider does not offer a persistent NameID, which eduLIMS requires.
idp_refused_metadata_no_signing_cert: The metadata has no signing certificate.
idp_refused_metadata_no_sso_service: The metadata has no single sign-on service with the HTTP-Redirect binding.
idp_refused_metadata_too_large: The metadata is larger than 100 KB.
idp_refused_no_pkce: The provider's discovery document does not offer PKCE with S256. If the provider enforces it anyway, switch on “This provider enforces PKCE with S256”.
idp_refused_unsupported_client_auth: The provider accepts only private-key client authentication, which eduLIMS does not offer yet.
idp_role_claim_oidc_help: A dot path into the ID token: roles for Entra ID app roles, realm_access.roles for Keycloak realm roles, groups for groups.
idp_role_claim_saml_help: The exact name of the SAML attribute that lists the roles or groups.
idp_role_map_empty: No values yet: nobody gets a role from this provider.
idp_role_map_help: Every value the provider sends that is listed here grants its eduLIMS role. Teacher and administrator may combine; student never combines with another role.
idp_secret_help_new: Stored encrypted. eduLIMS never shows it again.
idp_secret_set: A secret is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or enter a new one to rotate it.
idp_sp_key_help: A PEM private key. Register its certificate at the identity provider. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
idp_sp_key_set: A signing key is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or enter a new one to replace it.
idp_table_caption: Identity providers, in the order of the sign-in page
idp_test_claims_help: Only the names, never the values.
idp_test_help: Opens a sign-in through this provider in a new tab. It shows which claims arrive and which roles they give, and signs nobody in.
idp_test_not_found: This test does not exist, belongs to someone else or has expired. Start a new one.
idp_test_outcome_conflict: The roles conflict (student with another role): this sign-in would be refused.
idp_test_outcome_default: No listed value: the default role applies ({roles}).
idp_test_outcome_idp: The provider sent a listed value: the user gets {roles}.
idp_test_outcome_local: No listed value: an existing user keeps the roles an administrator gave them ({roles}).
idp_test_outcome_nameid: Refused: the provider sent a NameID that is not persistent. Set the NameID format of this client to persistent at the provider.
idp_test_outcome_no_role: No listed value and no default role: this sign-in would be refused.
idp_test_pending: No result yet. Finish the sign-in in the other tab, then reload this page.
idp_urls_title: Register these at the identity provider
language_save_failed: Your language could not be saved. Please try again.
login_description: Sign in with your organisation account to use eduLIMS.
login_email_check_failed: eduLIMS could not check this address. Try again.
login_email_help: eduLIMS sends you to your institution's sign-in page.
login_email_title: Sign in with your institution email
login_email_unknown: eduLIMS does not know this address. Use one of the sign-in buttons above.
login_error_account_not_linked: This email address already signs in through another sign-in method. Use that method, or ask an administrator.
login_error_blocked: Your account is blocked. Contact an administrator.
login_error_failed: Signing in failed. Try again or contact an administrator.
login_error_no_role: Your account has no role in eduLIMS yet. Contact an administrator.
login_error_provider_disabled: This sign-in option is switched off. Use another one, or contact an administrator.
login_error_role_conflict: Your account has conflicting roles. Contact your administrator.
login_error_saml_nameid: Your institution's sign-in did not send a permanent identifier, so eduLIMS cannot sign you in. Contact an administrator.
login_last_method: Last time you signed in with {method}.
login_no_method: No sign-in method is configured. Contact an administrator.
not_found_body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
portal_admin_intro: Manage users and roles, and watch the FerroEHR and FerroBRIDGE integrations.
portal_student_intro: This is where you will find your practicals, samples, measurement results and assessments.
portal_switch_save_failed: Your portal choice could not be saved. You will land on your usual portal next time.
portal_teacher_intro: This is where you will manage your practicals and review your students' results.
role_error_not_allowed: This combination of roles is not allowed: a student cannot also be a teacher or an administrator.
role_error_own_roles: You cannot change your own roles. Ask another administrator.

shortcut_focus_search: Go to the search field, on pages that have one
shortcuts_character_keys_description: Turn off ? and / if they get in the way, for example with speech input.
shortcuts_dialog_description: These shortcuts work anywhere in eduLIMS, except while you type in a field.
sign_out_failed: Signing out failed. Please try again.
ui_command_description: Search for a command to run.
